info.description: Existing NEXOS v1 API. Phase C documentation is not production deployment approval. Cookies/Origin/trusted HTTPS requirements remain authoritative. Default list caps and raw JSON are retained. JSON Schema cannot execute arbitrary normalization/refinements: named adapters document them without changing validators. Length checks use runtime UTF-16 semantics; generic JSON Schema Unicode length validation can differ.
info.title: NEXOS API

get.description: Role ADMIN required on every request. Legacy latest50, createdAt/id descending. Valid unexpired cookie required; production authenticated operations require trusted HTTPS. Opt in with pagination=cursor. Legacy requests omit metadata; bare limit/cursor are ignored without the mode. Live keyset traversal, not a snapshot: unchanged sort keys do not repeat; deleted/expired rows disappear; new rows before a boundary require restarting. Opaque cursors are endpoint/user/project scoped and expire15 minutes from first issuance without renewal. Invalid/expired/tampered/wrong-scope cursors400 after authentication/ownership. End: hasMore=false,nextCursor=null. No total/count. Cursor order: createdAt DESC,id DESC.
